title: Hopscotch
text:
Hopscotch is a traditional game for children. You draw a grid of boxes on the ground with chalk. Children throw a stone into the boxes and jump on one foot. It is fun to play with friends.

Many children in different countries play hopscotch. In some places, the boxes have different shapes. The game is simple, and you do not need expensive toys. The winner is the player who reaches the end first.

questions.text: What do you draw on the ground?

options: The player with the most stones
The player who reaches the end first
The player with the biggest shoes

questions.text: Why is hopscotch a good game for children who do not have much money?
options: Because it does not need expensive things
Because it is played only in one country
Because it takes many hours to finish

questions.text: What can we infer about hopscotch from the passage?
options: It is only played in one country
It is a modern video game
It needs a lot of money to play
It is played in many places around the world

vocabulary.definition: a pattern of crossing lines that makes boxes
a soft stick used to draw on the ground or a board
to move something quickly through the air with your hand

paragraph_translations: El avioncito es un juego tradicional para niños. Dibujas una cuadrícula de cuadros en el suelo con tiza. Los niños lanzan una piedra a los cuadros y saltan con un pie. Es divertido jugar con amigos.

Muchos niños en diferentes países juegan al avioncito. En algunos lugares, los cuadros tienen formas diferentes. El juego es sencillo y no necesitas juguetes caros. El ganador es el jugador que llega primero al final.
